events.info:
Event Date:

Tue, 09/22/2026 - 10:00am -Tue, 09/22/2026 - 12:00pm

Address:

26 Court Street
Public Meeting Space
Boston, MA 02201-2006
United States

Join the Office of Youth Engagement and Advancement (OYEA) for a Special Youth Policy Seminar on Graduate School Access!

Recent federal policy changes are restricting access to graduate level education for low-income and marginalized communities. New borrowing limits threaten to shut Boston youth out of professions that require advanced degrees such as healthcare, law, and higher education.
